title: dev.qory.runtime.result
description: The result a non-interactive session printed on its standard output: outcome, turns, cost and tokens.

session.description: The number of the session whose runtime wrote the record, from 1: the session of its dev.qory.session.started.

line.description: The number of the line of the session's standard output the record was read from, from 1, counting every line, whether it is a JSON object or not. The session sets it on an event of the output source; an event of a hook has none.

outcome.description: success, or the runtime's error kind: error_max_turns, error_during_execution.

result.description: The final response text, when the runtime printed one.

usage.description: The tokens of the runtime's launch so far, subagents included: Claude Code's modelUsage, summed over the models. A launch can write several result lines, and each has the launch's total up to it. The four counts do not overlap; their sum is the launch's total. Absent when the record has no token counts: unknown, never 0.

input.description: Input tokens neither read from nor written to the cache.

cache_read.description: Input tokens read from the cache.

cache_write.description: Input tokens written to the cache, of every cache lifetime.
